decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress high-pressure geothermal probe is a flagship innovation in a geothermal market that is growing with the German heat transition, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a standard product in the core geothermal range and benefits from rising heat pump demand.
The probe surface technology supports the geothermal line and costs little to maintain, though as a supporting feature it could be folded into other products.
Fire-protection steel profile systems are a core business for Jansen, driven by certification and steady construction demand.
Slim steel profile systems serve a durable architectural trend in which Jansen is well positioned.
The decorative surface system adds value to the profile portfolio at low marginal cost, although it is a more niche offering.
